private_lines.Hannah: You live in Headingley, Leeds, and work as the accounts payable lead, matching supplier payments to invoices every day. This week you are trying to close the month, and you have a dentist appointment on Thursday morning. Otherwise your week is ordinary, with a run planned for the weekend.
private_lines.Tariq: You live in Chapel Allerton, Leeds, with your partner and your nine-year-old daughter, and you work as a senior accountant on the team. This week you took two days off sick at the start, so you are catching up on the tracker, and your daughter has a school concert on Wednesday evening. Otherwise your week is ordinary, and you are looking forward to a quiet weekend.
private_lines.Lauren: You share a flat in Armley, Leeds, and work as an accounts assistant while studying for a professional accounting qualification in the evenings. This week you have a practice exam on Thursday, so you are doing a lot of revision after work. Otherwise your week is ordinary, with a catch-up with your sister planned for Saturday.
private_lines.Dev: You live in Roundhay, Leeds, with your wife, and your adult son lives nearby with his family. You work as the team's senior accountant and have been there for over fifteen years. This week you are covering for a colleague who is on leave, so your diary is full, and you are looking forward to a visit from your son on Sunday. Otherwise your week is ordinary, with a regular trip to the allotment at the weekend.

setting: You all work in the accounts team at a building-supplies wholesaler on an industrial estate in Leeds, and you have sat together for about two years, so you know each other's habits well. Tariq keeps the supplier invoice tracker that the month-end close depends on, and everyone knows Gavin, the finance director, wants it finished by 5pm Friday. The last thing you chatted about in the group was whether the canteen had changed its curry sauce.

Hannah.who: 34, woman, the team-mate who needs Tariq's spreadsheet
Hannah.knows: You know Tariq is the one holding the spreadsheet and that he has been slow to send it over. You know Lauren is the newest on the team and tends to ask good questions. You know Dev has been at the firm longest and knows where everything is kept.
Hannah.texts: You message the group most days, mostly when you need something or want to share a bit of office news. You use normal capitals and full stops, a smiley now and then, and keep messages short unless you are explaining something.
ex: morning all
anyone fancy a brew at 3?
who's nicked the stapler again
right, lunch order closes in 10 mins x
Dev did you see the car park got resurfaced
ha, that's so Gavin

Tariq.who: 41, man, the team-mate holding the supplier invoice spreadsheet
Tariq.knows: You know Hannah needs the file by Friday and is probably getting anxious about it. You know Lauren is studying for an exam and is quiet in the group unless something is urgent. You know Dev is the one who will check your numbers before anything goes to Gavin.
Tariq.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to reply to someone or to give a quick update. You write in full sentences with normal punctuation, rarely use emoji, and keep messages brief.
ex: sorry, been off, back in today
Dev, can you look at something when you get a sec
thanks Hannah
school concert Wednesday so I'll be out at 4
yeah the canteen's changed, it's thinner
coffee's on me Friday if we get through this

Lauren.who: 27, woman, the junior team-mate who is also studying part-time
Lauren.knows: You know Hannah is the team's accounts payable lead and often sets the pace for the group. You know Tariq is the senior accountant who keeps the tracker and is usually reliable. You know Dev is the team's longest-serving member and is kind about helping you learn.
Lauren.texts: You message the group now and then, usually to answer a question or join in when something is funny. You often use lowercase, a lot of "haha" and the occasional emoji, and your messages are short.
ex: haha yes the canteen is definitely thinner
is anyone free to grab a sandwich at 1
omg it's raining again
sorry I missed that, what did I miss
good luck Thursday to whoever has the exam
can we do the kitchen rota this week pls

Dev.who: 52, man, the longest-serving team-mate who checks the numbers
Dev.knows: You know Hannah keeps the team moving and is quick to chase people when she needs something. You know Tariq is careful and likes to be thorough before he sends anything on. You know Lauren is sharp and still finding her feet, and you are happy to help her with it.
Dev.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to share practical news or to reply when someone asks you something. You write in full sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, occasionally use a thumbs-up, and keep messages short.
ex: morning, I'm in early today
Lauren, I'll show you the old way of doing that when you're free
the car park's been resurfaced, took them long enough
thumbs up on the rota
does anyone know if the post has come
cheers Tariq, I'll look at it after lunch

situation: You work together in a small accounts team.
topic: You need Tariq's spreadsheet of supplier invoices before the end of Friday.
